name: A.X.E.: Judgment Day
deck: The Eternals go to war with mutants

name: Above and Beyond
deck: The Avengers must battle the Hulk... in Greece!

name: Age of Ultron
deck: Marvel's first 2013 crossover event, the Earth is plunged into chaos when Ultron returns and conquers it.

name: Avengers vs. X-Men
deck: Marvel Comics' 2012 event. As a repercussion from the events that took place in The Children's Crusade, Fear Itself, Schism, and X-Sanction, the Avengers and X-Men go to war over the return of the Phoenix Force.

name: Behold the Vision
deck: The Vision attacks the Avengers. Soon he overcomes his programming and reveals to the Avengers that he was created by Ultron. Together, Vision and the Avengers go to Ultron's lair where a battle ensues. Plus, can androids cry?

name: Bride of Ultron
deck: Ultron kidnaps Hank Pym and forces him to create a robotic bride for him. This story features the first appearance of Jocasta... obviously.

name: Celestial Madonna Saga
deck: After a portent heralding the awakening of the Celestial Madonna appears, the Avengers vow to protect her against those who would possess her: Kang the Conqueror, Rama-Tut, and Immortus, Lord of Limbo.

name: Civil War
deck: Following a catastrophic tragedy caused by superhumans, the US Government passes a Super-Human Registration Act that requires all super-powered individuals in the country to reveal their identities, disclose their powers and personal details, and register as government employees or risk indefinite incarceration. This causes a deep rift in the hero community, with some backing the Act while others oppose it.

name: Dark Reign
deck: The Invasion is finally over, and a group of villains lead by Norman Osborn are ready to turn the Marvel Universe upside down.

name: Death Song of Kulan Gath
deck: Avengers story arc.

name: Defenders War
deck: The Avengers battle the Defenders for possession of the Evil Eye. Eventually the two teams realize they are pawns of Loki and Dormmamu and work together to stop the Earth from being absorbed into the Dark Dimension.

name: Demon in a Bottle
deck: Tony Stark`s battle with alcoholism. Stark`s drinking problem surfaces several times and was the cause of his loss of Stark International.

name: Destiny War
deck: Immortus and the Time Keepers want to kill Rick Jones, before he acquires the Destiny Force.

name: Disassembled
deck: The world of the Avengers is rocked to its foundation in this cross-over event, leaving the Earth's Mightiest Heroes broken and changing their lives forever.

name: Fear Itself
deck: In a time of fear and uncertainty, the Avengers make plans to rebuild Asgard, while Sin enacts a mysterious plan to fulfill her destiny and resurrect a forgotten god of fear.

name: Heroes Reborn
deck: During this arc, the heroes of Earth were sent to a pocket dimension instead of being killed by Onslaught.

name: House of M
deck: Reality is flipped upside down by the Scarlet Witch when mutants are the ruling majority. This story arc occurred in Marvel Comics titles between 2005 and 2006.

name: Infinity
deck: While the Avengers join forces with a cosmic armada to repel the Builders, Thanos takes advantage of their absence to lay siege to Earth.

name: Invasion of Atlantis
deck: Namor leads the Avengers and Alpha Flight in a battle against Attuma who has taken over Atlantis and imprisoned Marrina.

name: Kang Dynasty
deck: Kang the Conqueror wants to conquer present day earth to save it.

name: Korvac Saga
deck: Avengers and the Guardians of the Galaxy face-off against Michael Korvac

name: Kree/Skrull War
deck: The Avengers defend Earth from being engulfed in an intergalactic conflict between the Kree Empire and Skrulls.

name: Lionheart of Avalon
deck: It seems like a routine mission when Captain America and Earth's Mightiest Heroes head to Great Britain to deal with the Wrecking Crew's latest scheme. But when things get out of hand, it takes the bravery of an innocent bystander to save them all. These events lead to the resurrection of a forgotten Marvel hero and the introduction of a new member of the Avengers!

name: Live Kree or Die
deck: The Kree Lunatic Legion have a plot to kill the human race. The Lunatic Legion were willing to sacrifice themselves in order to complete their objective.

name: Marvel Comics' Fast Lane
deck: Four-part anti-drug comic paid for by the U.S. Government and printed in Marvel Comics, as well as other kids magazines, in 1999-2000

name: Maximum Security
deck: Earth becomes a prisoner world for space convicts, a cleaver ruse hiding sinister ends.

name: Molecule Man
deck: The Dark Avengers are pitted against a foe they cannot defeat: A man with the power over every molecule in the world! Norman can't talk his way out of this one as the world gets turned upside down.

name: Nefaria Protocols
deck: The Thunderbolts and Earth's Mightiest Heroes stand side-by-side against Count Nefaria, master of ionic energy! But before they can confront the Count, they'll have to deal with their own ion-empowered teammates, Atlas and Wonder Man, both of whom have fallen under Nefaria's thrall and now act as his henchmen.

name: Once an Invader
deck: Who is the mysterious figure that claims to be Captain America, and what mission is he recruiting the super-soldiers of past wars to accomplish? As the new Invaders hit the battlefield, Namor the Sub-Mariner marshals his forces against a crucial island nation! But whose side will the Avengers be on?

name: Onslaught
deck: The culmination of the X-Traitor storyline and then leads in to Heroes Reborn. Onslaught attempted to recreate the world in his image, only to be defeated by the combined sacrifice of Earth's heroes.

name: Operation: Galactic Storm
deck: Operation: Galactic Storm was a 19 part Avengers event. It ran within Avengers, West Coast Avengers, Captain America, Thor, Quasar, Iron Man and Wonder Man comics of the time.

name: Planet Hulk
deck: Hulk gets trapped on another planet by the Illuminati where he overthrows the emperor and becomes their king. This story leads into the World War Hulk event.

name: Public Exposure
deck: When the public is reminded of Norman's terrible past, Norman's wheeling and dealing becomes a public concern. Plus, some of the Avengers are getting frisky with each other, and that can't be good.

name: Red Zone
deck: A deadly red mist containing a flesh-eating virus starts to spread in the USA killing thousand of people.

name: Serpent Crown Saga
deck: The Avengers fight the Set-serving Squadron Supreme in a clash between Earths.

name: Siege
deck: Norman Osborn's Dark Reign crumbles in the Siege of Asgard.

name: Standoff
deck: When a group of peasants are brutally murdered by their own Slokovian government because they worship Thor, he is furious and comes down to earth from Asgard to avenge those people. While Iron Man tries to stop Thor whith a special Thorbuster suit - destroying the entire surrouding area - Captain America tries a more human approach to reason with Thor.

name: Thanos War
deck: For many people, the definitive Captain Marvel and Thanos stories. Jim Starlin presents Captain Marvel's attempts to thwart Thanos' mad plot to achieve supremacy with the Cosmic Cube.

name: The Children's Crusade
deck: The one, true Scarlet Witch is back and it’s a race between the Avengers, Young Avengers, Magneto, the X-Men and Doctor Doom to find her. Each group has their own motives and all will stop at nothing to find the mutant who changed the world.

name: The Death of Captain America
deck: "The Death of Captain America" is a Captain America story arc written by Ed Brubaker with art by Steve Epting and published by Marvel Comics. The arc first appears in Captain America #25. The story arc had wide-sweeping effects throughout the Marvel Universe and was accompanied by a miniseries.

name: The Final Threat
deck: The mad Titan Thanos gathers the six Infinity Gems in a ruthless bid for interplanetary power! It's up to the Avengers to stop him! How far will the heroes go to beat a villain whose only goal is to win the favor of Death herself?

name: The Heroic Age
deck: The new "status quo" for the Marvel Universe in 2010 after the events of Siege.

name: The Initiative
deck: The Initiative is a comic book event dealing with the aftermath of the Marvel Universe's Civil War. Many comics were included in under the Initiative label.

name: The Morgan Conquest
deck: The Celtic Sorceress Morgan Le Fay changed the world to her image

name: The Nefaria Trilogy
deck: The Avengers battle Count Nefaria and his Lethal Legion.

name: The Search for She-Hulk
deck: With her powers out of control, She-Hulk goes berserk in the town of Bone, Idaho, and the assembled Avengers may not be enough to stop her, even when Hawkeye and the Hulk return to aid them!

name: The Trial of Yellowjacket
deck: The Downfall and Redemption of Hank Pym

name: Ultron Unlimited
deck: Ultron invades and slaughters the Slorenian population and the Avengers risk all to stop him.

name: Under Siege
deck: The Masters of Evil take over the Avengers Mansion

name: Utopia
deck: The mutant riots in San Francisco lead to the entire area being put under martial law & brings about the formation of the "Dark X-Men." The first Avengers/X-Men crossover in 15 years.

name: Winter Soldier
deck: A midnight call to duty brings Captain America aboard the S.H.I.E.L.D Heli-carrier to identify the corpse of his most feared adversary: the Red Skull! The shocking murder of Cap's oldest enemy may not be the end of the Skull's plans, however, because whoever shot the Skull has stolen his final project: an unfinished Cosmic Cube with the potential power to alter reality itself. Adding to the imminent danger, a cadre of the Skull's followers has already set in motion a plan to ignite bombs in the hearts of Pa

name: Yesterday Quest
deck: In 1958, the High Evolutionary's evolved and armored animal elite forced the Elder God Chthon back to his prison within Mount Wundagore! More than forty years later, The Avengers face the same challenge, only for Chthon to find his greatest power in their own ranks.
